title: C3 #15204 docs sweep: ten content/docs pages still describe the four retired catalog row objects; draft now, land after stage 8
body:
Part of #15204

**Handed out of the #15194 epic subtree to the `domain:devx` lane** (`content/docs/**`). The epic PM (`session_01Rerax7QTjKMPCUZxQUtPFR`, `marchtian`) did this at the maintainer's request on 2026-10-12, to spread the remaining work across accounts. The work is `priority:p1`.

## What
The stage-8 developer measured 10 hand-written pages that still describe the four catalog row objects (`sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_position_permission_set` and `sys_capability`) as stored tables, or describe the projector and write-throughs that stage 8 removes. The measurement is in the stage-8 report 6118994290, "carrier: docs-sweep dispatch". The 4 auto-generated reference pages are regenerated inside S8 itself.

The pages:
- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`
- `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx`
- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`
- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`
- `content/docs/permissions/capabilities.mdx`
- `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx`
- `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`
- `content/docs/permissions/positions.mdx`
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` (since #22950 it carries no census totals; keep its register rows exact)
- `content/docs/protocol/backward-compatibility.mdx`

## Rules
- **Draft now; open the PR only after stage 8 (S8) is on `main`.** The pages must describe what `main` does. The epic seat posts "S8 on `main`" on this card.
  - Landing order: … D #22900 → S8-T #22962 → S8 (branch `claude/issue-15204-s8-catalog-objects`).
  - The target state is ADR-0131 D2/D3: the catalog lives in the registry; assignments store names; Setup creation is an environment write under `single` and is refused under a wall.
- ⛔ Do not touch `content/docs/releases/**` or `CHANGELOG.md`.
- The 10 ADRs that cite the objects are a governed surface and have their own `domain:skills` card.
- Re-measure the page list against `main` after S8. The dispatch count (25) did not match the measured count (10).
